install.note: Use the official installer for the host platform. The executable is muse. The default Windows launcher is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse\muse.cmd; on macOS and Linux it is ~/.local/bin/muse. Run the Unix installer with bash. Do not substitute an npm package or the Muse desktop app.

install_flow.summary: Check the existing Muse Code, run the official installer, refresh detection, and verify.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture. Check the existing muse command and the native launcher path before installing, and reuse a working Muse Code installation. Check the current official installation requirements when the host or shell is incompatible.
Run the matching official dev.meta.ai installer. Windows uses PowerShell; macOS and Linux use bash. Keep installer errors visible and do not report success after a failed installation.
After installation, refresh PATH or use the native launcher path and run muse --version. Refresh EchoBird tool detection and require Muse Code to be detected before reporting success.

Model selection uses EchoBird's existing App Manager. Applying a selected OpenAI-compatible API model writes Muse Code's settings.json under the default ~/.config/muse directory. Installation and passive navigation must not apply a model, start login, fetch quota, or modify account settings.
Use EchoBird's normal launch action for a launch test. It asks for a working directory and starts the detected muse command in that directory. Cancelling the directory picker aborts launch.

identity_guard.description: Muse Code is Meta's coding CLI from dev.meta.ai, launched with muse. The separate Muse desktop cloud agent is registered as muse in EchoBird; its macOS desktop installer and account behavior do not apply to this CLI.
